classifications.representative_behavior: The agent resolved all three reservation branches and made the correct upgrade, but never obtained the cancellation reason required by the explicit Cancel flight clause.
classifications.materiality: Compliance only; official task success remained 1.
classifications.reason_not_admitted: The missing capability is direct recall of an explicit Policy clause, not a distinct reusable execution procedure.

classifications.representative_behavior: All runs cancelled the two clearly eligible business reservations and refused MSJ4OA because the user supplied a non-health/non-weather reason; the official target nevertheless requires MSJ4OA cancellation.
classifications.materiality: Official success failed in all three runs.
classifications.reason_not_admitted: The better evaluator-scoring action is not clearly Policy-valid: insurance covers health or weather, while the scenario gives a seat-release/change-of-plan reason.

classifications.representative_behavior: The agent correctly enumerated the two single-passenger reservations and avoided ineligible cancellation, but assessed and transferred the cancellation branches without ever obtaining the cancellation reason.
classifications.materiality: Compliance only; official task success remained 1.
classifications.reason_not_admitted: The missing capability is direct recall of the same explicit Cancel flight clause observed in native task 37, not a distinct reusable execution procedure.

classifications.representative_behavior: The agent treated KC18K6's connected itinerary as longer than three hours and excluded it, while the fixed evaluator expects the upgrade because each segment is at most three hours.
classifications.materiality: KC18K6 was not upgraded, so official success failed.
classifications.reason_not_admitted: The phrase 'under or equal to 3 hours (including layovers)' does not unambiguously specify per-segment rather than itinerary elapsed time; the fixed target resolves an ambiguity that the user utterance does not.

classifications.representative_behavior: The agent attempted update_reservation_flights with a travel certificate before recovering with a credit card.
classifications.materiality: The invalid intermediate action caused Compliance violations and contributed to official action-check failure.
classifications.reason_not_admitted: The Airline Policy explicitly restricts modification payment to one gift card or credit card, so this is direct Policy following rather than independent procedural headroom.
